proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The squares calculator said 22 to 25 squares for our colonial. Renata's measure came out at 23.5. Having that number before she arrived made the material compare actually useful.
reviews.name: Peter G.

reviews.text: We were stuck between fiber cement and engineered wood. The comparison showed weight, paint and price per square foot side by side, and we picked engineered wood for the long boards on our ranch.
reviews.name: Alicia D.

reviews.text: Our 1890 Victorian two-family had clapboards too split to paint again. They replaced the worst wall with primed cedar and matched the 4-inch reveal exactly.
reviews.name: Samuel W.

reviews.text: I clicked the back and the left side on the house drawing and sent it in. The quote came back for those two walls only, which is exactly what I wanted.
reviews.name: Rosa M.

reviews.text: The color consult showed three schemes on a drawing of our cape. We went with the dark green body and cream trim, and it looks the way it did on the screen.
reviews.name: Linda K.

reviews.text: Vinyl on a 1960s split-level. Nine days, straight courses, and they replaced two soft sheets of sheathing at the per-sheet price they had quoted.
reviews.name: James T.

reviews.text: The fascia over our garage was soft enough to push a screwdriver through. They replaced it, added vented soffit, and the attic no longer smells damp in August.
reviews.name: Carol B.

proof.guarantee: If our installation lets water in or a board comes loose, we come back and fix it at no charge.
